app/main.py\n     1\t\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n     2\t\n     3\tThe admin console lives under /admin; the public site is served at the same\n     4\tpaths the static export writes. Routes live in their own modules under\n     5\tapp/routes/ and are included here. Keep this file small.\n     6\t\"\"\"\n     7\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     8\t\n     9\tfrom fastapi import FastAPI, Request\n    10\tfrom fastapi.responses import RedirectResponse\n    11\t\n    12\tfrom app.guards import AccessDenied, NeedsLogin, render_access_denied\n    13\tfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard, pages, posts, public, users\n    14\t\n    15\t\n    16\tdef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    17\t    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    18\t    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    19\t    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    20\t    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    21\t    app.include_router(pages.router)\n    22\t    app.include_router(users.router)\n    23\t    app.include_router(public.router)  # last: its /{slug}.html matches broadly\n    24\t\n    25\t    @app.exception_handler(NeedsLogin)\n    26\t    def _redirect_to_login(request: Request, exc: NeedsLogin):\n    27\t        return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n    28\t\n    29\t    app.add_exception_handler(AccessDenied, render_access_denied)\n    30\t\n    31\t    return app\n    32\t\n    33\t\n    34\tapp = create_app()\n=== app/settings.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Configuration, read from the environment (never hard-code secrets).\n     2\t\n     3\tValues come from real environment variables first, then from `.env` in the\n     4\tproject root, so `cp .env.example .env` is the whole setup. `uv run` does not\n     5\tload `.env` by itself, and python-dotenv isn't in the fixed stack, hence the\n     6\tsmall reader below.\n     7\t\"\"\"\n     8\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     9\t\n    10\timport os\n    11\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    12\t\n    13\tROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]\n    14\tTEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\"\n    15\tSITE = ROOT / \"site\"\n    16\t\n    17\t\n    18\tdef load_dotenv(path: Path) -> None:\n    19\t    \"\"\"Copy KEY=VALUE lines from `path` into os.environ, never overriding a\n    20\t    variable that is already set. Blank lines and # comments are skipped.\"\"\"\n    21\t    try:\n    22\t        # utf-8-sig: PowerShell's Out-File writes a BOM, which would otherwise\n    23\t        # glue itself onto the first key and silently drop that variable.\n    24\t        lines = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8-sig\").splitlines()\n    25\t    except OSError:\n    26\t        return\n    27\t    for line in lines:\n    28\t        line = line.strip()\n    29\t        if not line or line.startswith(\"#\") or \"=\" not in line:\n    30\t            continue\n    31\t        key, value = line.split(\"=\", 1)\n    32\t        key, value = key.strip(), value.strip()\n    33\t        if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in \"\\\"'\":\n    34\t            value = value[1:-1]\n    35\t        os.environ.setdefault(key, value)\n    36\t\n    37\t\n    38\tload_dotenv(ROOT / \".env\")\n    39\t\n    40\t\n    41\tdef _project_path(raw: str) -> Path:\n    42\t    path = Path(raw)\n    43\t    return path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path\n    44\t\n    45\t\n    46\tSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\n    47\tDATABASE_PATH = _project_path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", \"cms.db\"))\n    48\tSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n    49\t# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n    50\t# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\n    51\tBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n=== app/db.py\n     1\t\"\"\"SQLite connection and schema. No ORM (see spec Implementation Decisions).\"\"\"\n     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     3\t\n     4\timport sqlite3\n     5\tfrom pathlib import Path\n     6\t\n     7\tfrom app import settings\n     8\t\n     9\tSCHEMA = \"\"\"\n    10\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    11\t    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    12\t    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    13\t    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    14\t    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    15\t    active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    16\t    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n    17\t);\n    18\t\n    19\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS content (\n    20\t    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    21\t    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('post', 'page')),\n    22\t    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    23\t    slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n    24\t    body_md TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    25\t    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')) DEFAULT 'draft',\n    26\t    author_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    27\t    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    28\t    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    29\t    -- Set on a Draft that is Scheduled (see CONTEXT.md): the UTC time after\n    30\t    -- which the next `cms publish` makes it Published. NULL otherwise.\n    31\t    publish_at TEXT,\n    32\t    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n    33\t);\n    34\t\n    35\t-- One row per saved version of a content item (see CONTEXT.md: Revision).\n    36\t-- `version` counts 1, 2, 3... within one item; `rolled_back_to` is set when\n    37\t-- the save was a Roll back, to the version it rolled back to.\n    38\tCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revisions (\n    39\t    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    40\t    content_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES content(id),\n    41\t    version INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    42\t    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    43\t    slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n    44\t    body_md TEXT NOT NULL,\n    45\t    saved_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    46\t    saved_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    47\t    rolled_back_to INTEGER,\n    48\t    UNIQUE (content_id, version)\n    49\t);\n    50\t\"\"\"\n    51\t\n    52\t\n    53\t# Items saved before revisions existed get one starting revision from their\n    54\t# current state, so their pre-T15 text can still be rolled back to. The last\n    55\t# editor was never stored, so the Author stands in as who saved it. A no-op\n    56\t# once every item has a revision.\n    57\tBACKFILL_REVISIONS = \"\"\"\n    58\tINSERT INTO revisions (content_id, version, title, slug, body_md, saved_by, saved_at)\n    59\tSELECT id, 1, title, slug, body_md, author_id, updated_at FROM content\n    60\tWHERE id NOT IN (SELECT content_id FROM revisions);\n    61\t\"\"\"\n    62\t\n    63\t# Columns added to existing tables after they were first created. CREATE\n    64\t# TABLE IF NOT EXISTS never changes a table that already exists, so a database\n    65\t# made before a column existed gains it here. Maps table -> [(column, type)].\n    66\tADDED_COLUMNS = {\"content\": [(\"publish_at\", \"TEXT\")]}\n    67\t\n    68\t# Database files already brought up to date by this process.\n    69\t_schema_ready: set[str] = set()\n    70\t\n    71\t\n    72\tdef _path(db_path: Path | None) -> Path:\n    73\t    # Read lazily (settings.DATABASE_PATH) so tests can monkeypatch it per-test.\n    74\t    return db_path if db_path is not None else settings.DATABASE_PATH\n    75\t\n    76\t\n    77\tdef _open(path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    78\t    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)\n    79\t    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    80\t    return conn\n    81\t\n    82\t\n    83\tdef connect(db_path: Path | None = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    84\t    \"\"\"Open a connection to the CMS database. The first open of each file in\n    85\t    a process runs init_db, so a database made before a newer table existed\n    86\t    works without a re-seed.\"\"\"\n    87\t    path = _path(db_path)\n    88\t    if str(Path(path).resolve()) not in _schema_ready:\n    89\t        init_db(path)\n    90\t    return _open(path)\n    91\t\n    92\t\n    93\tdef _add_missing_columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    94\t    for table, columns in ADDED_COLUMNS.items():\n    95\t        present = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n    96\t        for name, sql_type in columns:\n    97\t            if name not in present:\n    98\t                conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {name} {sql_type}\")\n    99\t\n   100\t\n   101\tdef init_db(db_path: Path | None = None) -> None:\n   102\t    \"\"\"Create any missing tables and columns, and backfill starting\n   103\t    revisions. Safe to run on a new or an existing database, any number of\n   104\t    times.\"\"\"\n   105\t    path = _path(db_path)\n   106\t    conn = _open(path)\n   107\t    try:\n   108\t        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n   109\t        _add_missing_columns(conn)\n   110\t        conn.executescript(BACKFILL_REVISIONS)\n   111\t        conn.commit()\n   112\t    finally:\n   113\t        conn.close()\n   114\t    _schema_ready.add(str(Path(path).resolve()))\n=== app/mdrender.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Markdown -> sanitized HTML: the one pipeline the admin preview and the\n     2\tlater static export (T07) both reuse, so a post can't render one way in the\n     3\teditor and another way once published. The one deliberate difference is a\n     4\tlink to the site root, which the export makes relative (`to_root` below).\n     5\t\"\"\"\n     6\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     7\t\n     8\tfrom collections.abc import Callable\n     9\t\n    10\timport nh3\n    11\tfrom markdown_it import MarkdownIt\n    12\t\n    13\t_md = MarkdownIt(\"commonmark\")\n    14\t\n    15\t# What a browser ignores before it reads a URL (WHATWG URL parsing): spaces\n    16\t# and control characters at either end, and tabs and newlines anywhere.\n    17\t_TRIMMED = \"\".join(chr(code) for code in range(0x21))\n    18\t_DROPPED = {ord(\"\\t\"): None, ord(\"\\n\"): None, ord(\"\\r\"): None}\n    19\t\n    20\t\n    21\tdef render_markdown(raw: str, *, to_root: str | None = None) -> str:\n    22\t    \"\"\"Render Markdown to HTML, then strip anything unsafe (script tags,\n    23\t    event-handler attributes like onerror=, javascript: URLs, ...).\n    24\t\n    25\t    `to_root` is set when the HTML is written into site/: the \"../\" steps\n    26\t    from that file back to the site root (\"\" for a Page, \"../\" for a Post).\n    27\t    A link written in a body from the site root (`/contact-us.html`) is then\n    28\t    made relative to the file, because GitHub Pages serves the site from a\n    29\t    subfolder. Unset (the admin preview), links stay as written: the admin\n    30\t    server serves the public pages at its own root, so they resolve there.\n    31\t    \"\"\"\n    32\t    html = _md.render(raw)\n    33\t    if to_root is None:\n    34\t        return nh3.clean(html)\n    35\t    return nh3.clean(html, attribute_filter=_root_link_rewriter(to_root))\n    36\t\n    37\t\n    38\tdef _root_link_rewriter(to_root: str) -> Callable[[str, str, str], str]:\n    39\t    \"\"\"An nh3 attribute filter that rewrites every href/src a browser would\n    40\t    read as root-absolute or protocol-relative.\n    41\t\n    42\t    nh3 checks URL schemes before it calls the filter, never after, so a\n    43\t    rewritten value must never be able to start a scheme: it always begins\n    44\t    with \"./\", \"../\" or \"https://\". Dropping only the \"/\" would turn\n    45\t    \"/javascript:alert(1)\" into a live javascript: link.\n    46\t    \"\"\"\n    47\t    prefix = to_root or \"./\"\n    48\t\n    49\t    def rewrite(tag: str, attribute: str, value: str) -> str:\n    50\t        if attribute not in (\"href\", \"src\"):\n    51\t            return value\n    52\t        url = value.strip(_TRIMMED).translate(_DROPPED).replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\")\n    53\t        if url.startswith(\"//\"):\n    54\t            return \"https:\" + url  # protocol-relative; GitHub Pages is HTTPS-only\n    55\t        if url.startswith(\"/\"):\n    56\t            rest = url[1:]\n    57\t            if rest == \"\" or rest[0] in \"#?\":\n    58\t                rest = \"index.html\" + rest  # \"/\" is the home page\n    59\t            return prefix + rest\n    60\t        return value\n    61\t\n    62\t    return rewrite\n=== app/publish.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Render the public site into site/ as plain HTML.\n     2\t\n     3\tT00 publishes a placeholder home page. As you build content types, extend\n     4\trender_site() to write one file per published item. Two rules the rubric checks:\n     5\t\n     6\t  1. Only PUBLISHED content is written here. A draft that reaches site/ is a bug.\n     7\t  2. Every href and src is RELATIVE (\"style.css\", \"posts/x.html\"), never\n     8\t     root-absolute (\"/style.css\"), because Pages serves this from a subfolder.\n     9\t     That includes links written in a body: render_markdown(..., to_root=...)\n    10\t     rewrites \"/contact-us.html\" for the file it lands in.\n    11\t\"\"\"\n    12\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    13\t\n    14\timport shutil\n    15\tfrom pathlib import Path\n    16\t\n    17\tfrom jinja2 import Environment, FileSystemLoader, select_autoescape\n    18\t\n    19\tfrom app import content as content_module\n    20\tfrom app import settings\n    21\tfrom app.mdrender import render_markdown\n    22\t\n    23\t# One stylesheet for the public site and the admin console (served at /style.css).\n    24\tCSS = Path(__file__).with_name(\"style.css\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    25\t\n    26\t\n    27\tdef environment() -> Environment:\n    28\t    return Environment(\n    29\t        loader=FileSystemLoader(str(settings.TEMPLATES)),\n    30\t        autoescape=select_autoescape([\"html\"]),\n    31\t    )\n    32\t\n    33\t\n    34\tdef nav_items(prefix: str = \"\") -> list[dict[str, str]]:\n    35\t    \"\"\"Published Pages, as relative (title, href) links for the public\n    36\t    site's nav. `prefix` relocates the link for a page nested one\n    37\t    directory deep (e.g. \"../\" from site/posts/*.html) — a draft Page\n    38\t    never appears here.\"\"\"\n    39\t    return [{\"title\": page[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"{prefix}{page['slug']}.html\"}\n    40\t            for page in _exportable_pages()]\n    41\t\n    42\t\n    43\tdef _exportable_pages() -> list:\n    44\t    # The editor already refuses reserved slugs; this also covers rows saved\n    45\t    # before that check existed, so a Page can never overwrite site/index.html.\n    46\t    return [page for page in content_module.list_published(\"page\")\n    47\t            if not content_module.reserved_slug_reason(\"page\", page[\"slug\"])]\n    48\t\n    49\t\n    50\tdef _date(item) -> str:\n    51\t    \"\"\"The calendar day an item was created, e.g. \"2026-10-07\".\"\"\"\n    52\t    return item[\"created_at\"][:10]\n    53\t\n    54\t\n    55\tdef home_html() -> str:\n    56\t    \"\"\"The home page (feed of published Posts), as written to site/index.html.\"\"\"\n    57\t    posts = content_module.list_published(\"post\")\n    58\t    return environment().get_template(\"public/home.html\").render(\n    59\t        title=settings.SITE_TITLE, items=[\n    60\t            {\"title\": post[\"title\"], \"href\": f\"posts/{post['slug']}.html\",\n    61\t             \"date\": _date(post)} for post in posts\n    62\t        ],\n    63\t        css_path=\"style.css\", home_path=\"index.html\", nav_items=nav_items(),\n    64\t    )\n    65\t\n    66\t\n    67\tdef post_html(post) -> str:\n    68\t    \"\"\"A published Post, as written to site/posts/<slug>.html — one directory\n    69\t    deep, so every shared link climbs a level.\"\"\"\n    70\t    return _detail_html(\"public/post.html\", \"post\", post, prefix=\"../\")\n    71\t\n    72\t\n    73\tdef page_html(page) -> str:\n    74\t    \"\"\"A published Page, as written to site/<slug>.html.\"\"\"\n    75\t    return _detail_html(\"public/page.html\", \"page\", page, prefix=\"\")\n    76\t\n    77\t\n    78\tdef _detail_html(template_name: str, item_key: str, item, *, prefix: str) -> str:\n    79\t    return environment().get_template(template_name).render(\n    80\t        title=item[\"title\"], site_title=settings.SITE_TITLE,\n    81\t        **{item_key: item}, date=_date(item),\n    82\t        body_html=render_markdown(item[\"body_md\"], to_root=prefix),\n    83\t        css_path=f\"{prefix}style.css\", home_path=f\"{prefix}index.html\",\n    84\t        nav_items=nav_items(prefix=prefix),\n    85\t    )\n    86\t\n    87\t\n    88\tdef _write(path: Path, text: str) -> None:\n    89\t    # Explicit UTF-8: the pages declare <meta charset=\"utf-8\">, and the\n    90\t    # platform default (cp1252 on Windows) can't encode an emoji at all.\n    91\t    path.write_text(text, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    92\t\n    93\t\n    94\tdef render_site(out: Path | None = None) -> Path:\n    95\t    out = out or settings.SITE\n    96\t    if out.exists():\n    97\t        shutil.rmtree(out)\n    98\t    out.mkdir(parents=True)\n    99\t    _write(out / \"style.css\", CSS)\n   100\t    _write(out / \"index.html\", home_html())\n   101\t\n   102\t    posts_dir = out / \"posts\"\n   103\t    posts_dir.mkdir()\n   104\t    for post in content_module.list_published(\"post\"):\n   105\t        _write(posts_dir / f\"{post['slug']}.html\", post_html(post))\n   106\t    for page in _exportable_pages():\n   107\t        _write(out / f\"{page['slug']}.html\", page_html(page))\n   108\t\n   109\t    return out\n=== app/security.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Password hashing, signed sessions, and CSRF tokens.\n     2\t\n     3\tSessions are a signed cookie (itsdangerous): the cookie holds the user's id,\n     4\tsigned so it can't be forged or edited client-side, with no server-side\n     5\tsession store. CSRF uses the double-submit pattern with the same signer: a\n     6\trandom token is set as a signed cookie and echoed back in the form; a POST\n     7\tis rejected unless the submitted value matches what the cookie's signature\n     8\tverifies to.\n     9\t\"\"\"\n    10\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    11\t\n    12\timport hmac\n    13\timport secrets\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\n    16\tfrom argon2.exceptions import VerificationError, VerifyMismatchError\n    17\tfrom itsdangerous import BadSignature, SignatureExpired, URLSafeTimedSerializer\n    18\t\n    19\tfrom app import settings\n    20\t\n    21\tSESSION_COOKIE = \"session\"\n    22\tCSRF_COOKIE = \"csrf_token_signed\"\n    23\tSESSION_MAX_AGE = 60 * 60 * 8  # 8 hours\n    24\t\n    25\t_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n    26\t_session_signer = URLSafeTimedSerializer(settings.SECRET_KEY, salt=\"session\")\n    27\t_csrf_signer = URLSafeTimedSerializer(settings.SECRET_KEY, salt=\"csrf\")\n    28\t\n    29\t\n    30\tdef hash_password(raw: str) -> str:\n    31\t    return _hasher.hash(raw)\n    32\t\n    33\t\n    34\tdef verify_password(raw: str, hashed: str) -> bool:\n    35\t    try:\n    36\t        return _hasher.verify(hashed, raw)\n    37\t    except (VerifyMismatchError, VerificationError):\n    38\t        return False\n    39\t\n    40\t\n    41\tdef sign_session(user_id: int) -> str:\n    42\t    return _session_signer.dumps({\"uid\": user_id})\n    43\t\n    44\t\n    45\tdef read_session(token: str | None) -> int | None:\n    46\t    if not token:\n    47\t        return None\n    48\t    try:\n    49\t        data = _session_signer.loads(token, max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE)\n    50\t    except (BadSignature, SignatureExpired):\n    51\t        return None\n    52\t    return data.get(\"uid\")\n    53\t\n    54\t\n    55\tdef new_csrf_pair() -> tuple[str, str]:\n    56\t    \"\"\"Return (raw_token_for_the_form, signed_token_for_the_cookie).\"\"\"\n    57\t    raw = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    58\t    return raw, _csrf_signer.dumps(raw)\n    59\t\n    60\t\n    61\tdef verify_csrf(form_token: str | None, signed_cookie: str | None) -> bool:\n    62\t    if not form_token or not signed_cookie:\n    63\t        return False\n    64\t    try:\n    65\t        raw = _csrf_signer.loads(signed_cookie, max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE)\n    66\t    except (BadSignature, SignatureExpired):\n    67\t        return False\n    68\t    return hmac.compare_digest(raw, form_token)\n    69\t\n    70\t\n    71\tdef set_csrf_cookie(response, new_cookie: str | None):\n    72\t    \"\"\"Set the CSRF cookie on `response` if read_or_mint_csrf minted a new\n    73\t    one (it returns None when the request's existing cookie was reused).\"\"\"\n    74\t    if new_cookie is not None:\n    75\t        response.set_cookie(CSRF_COOKIE, new_cookie, httponly=True, samesite=\"lax\")\n    76\t    return response\n    77\t\n    78\t\n    79\tdef read_or_mint_csrf(request) -> tuple[str, str | None]:\n    80\t    \"\"\"Reuse the request's existing valid CSRF cookie if it has one, so a\n    81\t    second page load doesn't invalidate a token already embedded in a page\n    82\t    the user still has open. Returns (raw_token_for_the_form,\n    83\t    new_signed_cookie_value_or_None) — the caller only needs to call\n    84\t    response.set_cookie(...) when the second element isn't None.\"\"\"\n    85\t    existing_signed = request.cookies.get(CSRF_COOKIE)\n    86\t    if existing_signed:\n    87\t        try:\n    88\t            return _csrf_signer.loads(existing_signed, max_age=SESSION_MAX_AGE), None\n    89\t        except (BadSignature, SignatureExpired):\n    90\t            pass\n    91\t    raw, signed = new_csrf_pair()\n    92\t    return raw, signed\n=== app/templating.py\n     1\t\"\"\"The one Jinja2Templates instance the admin console renders with.\"\"\"\n     2\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n     3\t\n     4\tfrom fastapi import Request\n     5\tfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n     6\t\n     7\tfrom app import settings\n     8\t\n     9\t\n    10\tdef _relative_root(request: Request) -> dict[str, str]:\n    11\t    \"\"\"`to_root`: the \"../\" steps from the current URL back to the server root,\n    12\t    so admin links are relative like the published site's, e.g.\n    13\t    /admin -> \"\", /admin/posts -> \"../\", /admin/posts/3/edit -> \"../../../\".\"\"\"\n    14\t    return {\"to_root\": \"../\" * max(request.url.path.count(\"/\") - 1, 0)}\n    15\t\n    16\t\n    17\tdef utc_time(stamp: str) -> str:\n    18\t    \"\"\"A stored UTC timestamp (\"2026-10-08 09:30:00\") as shown in the admin\n    19\t    console: to the minute, marked UTC, e.g. \"2026-10-08 09:30 UTC\".\"\"\"\n    20\t    return f\"{stamp[:16]} UTC\"\n    21\t\n    22\t\n    23\ttemplates = Jinja2Templates(\n    24\t    directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES), context_processors=[_relative_root],\n    25\t)\n    26\ttemplates.env.filters[\"utc_time\"] = utc_time\n=== app/guards.py\n     1\t\"\"\"Route-access guards: authenticated, editor-or-admin, admin-only.\n     2\t\n     3\tFastAPI dependencies can't return a redirect directly, so an anonymous visit\n     4\traises NeedsLogin, which create_app() maps to a redirect via an exception\n     5\thandler. A wrong role raises AccessDenied (a 403) instead — there's nowhere\n     6\tuseful to redirect a logged-in user who simply lacks permission, so\n     7\tcreate_app() renders it as an \"Access denied\" page inside the admin layout.\n     8\t\"\"\"\n     9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    10\t\n    11\timport sqlite3\n    12\t\n    13\tfrom fastapi import HTTPException, Request\n    14\t\n    15\tfrom app import security\n    16\tfrom app.routes.auth import current_user\n    17\tfrom app.templating import templates\n    18\t\n    19\t\n    20\tclass NeedsLogin(Exception):\n    21\t    \"\"\"Raised by require_login() when there's no authenticated user.\"\"\"\n    22\t\n    23\t\n    24\tclass AccessDenied(HTTPException):\n    25\t    \"\"\"Raised when a logged-in user's role doesn't allow the request.\"\"\"\n    26\t\n    27\t    def __init__(self, detail: str, user: sqlite3.Row) -> None:\n    28\t        super().__init__(403, detail=detail)\n    29\t        self.user = user\n a\n     7\tPost in `posts/` it becomes `../contact-us.html`.\n     8\t\"\"\"\n     9\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n    10\t\n    11\timport re\n    12\tfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, 35\t\n    36\tdef _href(html: str, link_text: str) -> str:\n    37\t    \"\"\"The href of the body link whose text is `link_text` (not a nav link).\"\"\"\n    38\t    match = re.search(rf'<a href=\"([^\"]*)\"[^>]*>{re.escape(link_text)}</a>', html)\n    39\t    assert match, f\"no link {link_text!r} in the page\"\n    40\t    return match.group(1)\n    41\t\n    42\t\n    43\tdef _img_src(html: str, alt: str) -> str:\n    44\t    tag = re.search(rf'<img [^>]*alt=\"{re.escape(alt)}\"[^>]*>', html)\n    45\t    assert tag, f\"no image {alt!r} in the page\"\n    46\t    return {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"39a0ae77-23dc-47a0-8ea7-552f47020b4e","hash":"04011098876db4a592aced55f5caeac0a0db068348df78f5c35f4ff111694132","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"tool_result","tool_use_id":"toolu_01Wx8KqNGSsfTA92cCW3eT3a","content":"Launching skill: mattpocock-skills:tdd"},{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: C:\\Users\\rajan\\.claude\\plugins\\cache\\claude-plugins-official\\mattpocock-skills\\1.3.1\\skills\\engineering\\tdd\n\n# Test-Driven Development\r\n\r\nTDD is the red → green loop. This skill is the reference that makes that loop produce tests worth keeping: what a good test is, where tests go, the anti-patterns, and the rules of the loop. Every section applies on every cycle: consult them before and during the loop, not after.\r\n\r\nWhen exploring the codebase, read `GLOSSARY.md` (if it exists) so test names and interface vocabulary match the project's domain language, and respect ADRs in the area you're touching.\r\n\r\n## What a good test is\r\n\r\nTests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details. Code can change entirely; tests shouldn't. A good test reads like a specification: \"user can checkout with valid cart\" tells you exactly what capability exists, and it survives refactors because it doesn't care about internal structure.\r\n\r\nSee [tests.md](tests.md) for examples and [mocking.md](mocking.md) for mocking guidelines.\r\n\r\n## Seams: where tests go\r\n\r\nA **seam** is the public boundary you test at: the interface where you observe behavior without reaching inside. Tests live at seams, never against internals.\r\n\r\n**Test only at pre-agreed seams.** Before writing any test, write down the seams under test and confirm them with the user. No test is written at an unconfirmed seam. You can't test everything, so agreeing the seams up front is how testing effort lands on the critical paths and complex logic instead of every edge case.\r\n\r\nAsk: \"What's the public interface, and which seams should we test?\" Give each proposed seam a one-line note on what it catches and what it misses.\r\n\r\nWhen the shape of that interface is itself in question (how deep the module is, where the seam belongs, what the interface should expose), call the Skill tool with \"codebase-design\" for the vocabulary. It is the shared source of the module, interface, depth, seam, adapter, leverage and locality terms, and it is a reference to consult, not a session to run.\r\n\r\n## Anti-patterns\r\n\r\n- **Implementation-coupled**: mocks internal collaborators, tests private methods, or verifies through a side channel (querying the database instead of using the interface). The tell: the test breaks when you refactor but behavior hasn't changed.\r\n- **Tautological**: the assertion recomputes the expected value the way the code does (`expect(add(a, b)).toBe(a + b)`, a snapshot derived by hand the same way, a constant asserted equal to itself), so it passes by construction and can never disagree with the code. Expected values must come from an independent source of truth: a known-good literal, a worked example, the spec.\r\n- **Horizontal slicing**: writing all tests first, then all implementation. Bulk tests verify _imagined_ behavior: you test the _shape_ of things rather than user-facing behavior, the tests go insensitive to real changes, and you commit to test structure before understanding the implementation. Work in **vertical slices** instead: one test → one implementation → repeat, each test a **tracer bullet** that responds to what the last cycle taught you.\r\n\r\n## Rules of the loop\r\n\r\n- **Red before green.** Write the failing test first, then only enough code to pass it. Don't anticipate future tests or add speculative features.\r\n- **One slice at a time.** One seam, one test, one minimal implementation per cycle.\r\n- **Refactoring is not part of the loop.** It belongs to the review stage (see the `code-review` skill), not the red → green implementation cycle.\r\n\n\nARGUMENTS: Issue #21 media uploads: tests in tests/test_media.py named test_step<k>_<what>, one vertical slice per acceptance step."}]}}

{"parentUuid":"5e22989b-05ac-45c1-bd08-f4e4bb4cd68e","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgEaypVJQPvk8qqwoDGEA","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01XoqWfBrsoufsJ3jqYNaQwz","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\tests\\test_media.py","content":"\"\"\"MP2plus F1: media uploads with alt text (issue #21).\n\nAn Editor or Admin uploads a PNG or JPEG of 2 MB or less, with alt text, to\nthe media library; copies the item's Markdown snippet, `![alt](media/<file>)`,\ninto a Post; and `cms publish` copies media/ into site/media/ with each\n`<img src>` made relative to the page it is on. Each test is named after the\nacceptance step on #21 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport struct\nimport zlib\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _png(width: int = 2, height: int = 2) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"A real (tiny, red) PNG image, built by hand: no imaging library.\"\"\"\n    def chunk(kind: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:\n        return (struct.pack(\">I\", len(data)) + kind + data\n                + struct.pack(\">I\", zlib.crc32(kind + data)))\n\n    rows = b\"\".join(b\"\\x00\" + b\"\\xff\\x00\\x00\" * width for _ in range(height))\n    return (b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\"\n            + chunk(b\"IHDR\", struct.pack(\">IIBBBBB\", width, height, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))\n            + chunk(b\"IDAT\", zlib.compress(rows)) + chunk(b\"IEND\", b\"\"))\n\n\nPNG = _png()\n# Starts the way every JPEG does (FF D8 FF); the server never decodes it.\nJPEG = b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\\xe0\\x00\\x10JFIF\\x00\" + bytes(32) + b\"\\xff\\xd9\"\nALT = \"A red square\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef media_dir(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Uploads land in this test's own media/, never the real one.\"\"\"\n    media = tmp_path / \"media\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"MEDIA\", media)\n    return media\n\n\ndef _upload(client, filename: str, data: bytes, alt: str = ALT, *, csrf: str | None = None):\n    \"\"\"Send the library's upload form, with its own CSRF token unless\n    `csrf` says otherwise (\"\" leaves the token out).\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(client.get(\"/admin/media\").text) if csrf is None else csrf\n    form = {\"alt_text\": alt}\n    if token:\n        form[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return client.post(\"/admin/media/upload\", data=form,\n                       files={\"image\": (filename, data, \"application/octet-stream\")})\n\n\ndef _img_src(html: str, alt: str) -> str:\n    tag = re.search(rf'<img [^>]*alt=\"{re.escape(alt)}\"[^>]*>', html)\n    assert tag, f\"no image {alt!r} in the page\"\n    return unescape(re.search(r'src=\"([^\"]*)\"', tag.group(0)).group(1))\n\n\n# -- Step 1: upload a PNG or JPEG of 2 MB or less; it appears in the library --\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"filename, data\", [\n    (\"square.png\", PNG), (\"photo.jpg\", JPEG), (\"photo.jpeg\", JPEG),\n])\ndef test_step1_png_or_jpeg_with_alt_text_appears_in_the_library(client_as, role, filename, data):\n    client = client_as(role)\n    library = _upload(client, filename, data)\n\n    assert library.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Image uploaded\" in library.text\n    src = _img_src(library.text, ALT)\n    assert not src.startswith(\"/\"), src\n    image = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/admin/media\", src)).path)\n    assert image.status_code == 200\n    assert image.content == data\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3551,"cache_read_input_tokens":154662,"output_tokens":13847,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":12396},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3551,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":13847,"cache_read_input_tokens":154662,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3551,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3551},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01XoqWfBrsoufsJ3jqYNaQwz":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\tests\\test_media.py","content":"\"\"\"MP2plus F1: media uploads with alt text (issue #21).\n\nAn Editor or Admin uploads a PNG or JPEG of 2 MB or less, with alt text, to\nthe media library; copies the item's Markdown snippet, `![alt](media/<file>)`,\ninto a Post; and `cms publish` copies media/ into site/media/ with each\n`<img src>` made relative to the page it is on. Each test is named after the\nacceptance step on #21 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport struct\nimport zlib\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _png(width: int = 2, height: int = 2) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"A real (tiny, red) PNG image, built by hand: no imaging library.\"\"\"\n    def chunk(kind: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:\n        return (struct.pack(\">I\", len(data)) + kind + data\n                + struct.pack(\">I\", zlib.crc32(kind + data)))\n\n    rows = b\"\".join(b\"\\x00\" + b\"\\xff\\x00\\x00\" * width for _ in range(height))\n    return (b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\"\n            + chunk(b\"IHDR\", struct.pack(\">IIBBBBB\", width, height, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))\n            + chunk(b\"IDAT\", zlib.compress(rows)) + chunk(b\"IEND\", b\"\"))\n\n\nPNG = _png()\n# Starts the way every JPEG does (FF D8 FF); the server never decodes it.\nJPEG = b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\\xe0\\x00\\x10JFIF\\x00\" + bytes(32) + b\"\\xff\\xd9\"\nALT = \"A red square\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef media_dir(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Uploads land in this test's own media/, never the real one.\"\"\"\n    media = tmp_path / \"media\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"MEDIA\", media)\n    return media\n\n\ndef _upload(client, filename: str, data: bytes, alt: str = ALT, *, csrf: str | None = None):\n    \"\"\"Send the library's upload form, with its own CSRF token unless\n    `csrf` says otherwise (\"\" leaves the token out).\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(client.get(\"/admin/media\").text) if csrf is None else csrf\n    form = {\"alt_text\": alt}\n    if token:\n        form[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return client.post(\"/admin/media/upload\", data=form,\n                       files={\"image\": (filename, data, \"application/octet-stream\")})\n\n\ndef _img_src(html: str, alt: str) -> str:\n    tag = re.search(rf'<img [^>]*alt=\"{re.escape(alt)}\"[^>]*>', html)\n    assert tag, f\"no image {alt!r} in the page\"\n    return unescape(re.search(r'src=\"([^\"]*)\"', tag.group(0)).group(1))\n\n\n# -- Step 1: upload a PNG or JPEG of 2 MB or less; it appears in the library --\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"filename, data\", [\n    (\"square.png\", PNG), (\"photo.jpg\", JPEG), (\"photo.jpeg\", JPEG),\n])\ndef test_step1_png_or_jpeg_with_alt_text_appears_in_the_library(client_as, role, filename, data):\n    client = client_as(role)\n    library = _upload(client, filename, data)\n\n    assert library.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Image uploaded\" in library.text\n    src = _img_src(library.text, ALT)\n    assert not src.startswith(\"/\"), src\n    image = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/admin/media\", src)).path)\n    assert image.status_code == 200\n    assert image.content == data\n"}},"serverClassifierRequest":"26b24925-3d80-4b33-95e2-f6282173cd69","apiBlockIndex":2,"requestId":"req_011CgEaypAxYNsnBUxhHsCNw","requestRef":"ecff4613-c068-4a9a-924c-4d638a3b7863","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:tdd","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"86925a72-be3f-44c2-a8ad-ed97ba20ca4c","timestamp":"2026-10-21T02:25:13.047Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"xhigh","perTurnEffort":"xhigh","session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"39a0ae77-23dc-47a0-8ea7-552f47020b4e","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"86925a72-be3f-44c2-a8ad-ed97ba20ca4c","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"dd968fe8-910e-4bf4-aec4-5598d8f95603","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01XoqWfBrsoufsJ3jqYNaQwz","type":"tool_result","content":"File created successfully at: C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\tests\\test_media.py (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"04e7a095-046e-42e1-8084-277e3dec3e6b","timestamp":"2026-10-21T02:25:13.365Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"create","filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\tests\\test_media.py","content":"\"\"\"MP2plus F1: media uploads with alt text (issue #21).\n\nAn Editor or Admin uploads a PNG or JPEG of 2 MB or less, with alt text, to\nthe media library; copies the item's Markdown snippet, `![alt](media/<file>)`,\ninto a Post; and `cms publish` copies media/ into site/media/ with each\n`<img src>` made relative to the page it is on. Each test is named after the\nacceptance step on #21 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport struct\nimport zlib\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _png(width: int = 2, height: int = 2) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"A real (tiny, red) PNG image, built by hand: no imaging library.\"\"\"\n    def chunk(kind: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:\n        return (struct.pack(\">I\", len(data)) + kind + data\n                + struct.pack(\">I\", zlib.crc32(kind + data)))\n\n    rows = b\"\".join(b\"\\x00\" + b\"\\xff\\x00\\x00\" * width for _ in range(height))\n    return (b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\"\n            + chunk(b\"IHDR\", struct.pack(\">IIBBBBB\", width, height, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))\n            + chunk(b\"IDAT\", zlib.compress(rows)) + chunk(b\"IEND\", b\"\"))\n\n\nPNG = _png()\n# Starts the way every JPEG does (FF D8 FF); the server never decodes it.\nJPEG = b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\\xe0\\x00\\x10JFIF\\x00\" + bytes(32) + b\"\\xff\\xd9\"\nALT = \"A red square\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef media_dir(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Uploads land in this test's own media/, never the real one.\"\"\"\n    media = tmp_path / \"media\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"MEDIA\", media)\n    return media\n\n\ndef _upload(client, filename: str, data: bytes, alt: str = ALT, *, csrf: str | None = None):\n    \"\"\"Send the library's upload form, with its own CSRF token unless\n    `csrf` says otherwise (\"\" leaves the token out).\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(client.get(\"/admin/media\").text) if csrf is None else csrf\n    form = {\"alt_text\": alt}\n    if token:\n        form[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return client.post(\"/admin/media/upload\", data=form,\n                       files={\"image\": (filename, data, \"application/octet-stream\")})\n\n\ndef _img_src(html: str, alt: str) -> str:\n    tag = re.search(rf'<img [^>]*alt=\"{re.escape(alt)}\"[^>]*>', html)\n    assert tag, f\"no image {alt!r} in the page\"\n    return unescape(re.search(r'src=\"([^\"]*)\"', tag.group(0)).group(1))\n\n\n# -- Step 1: upload a PNG or JPEG of 2 MB or less; it appears in the library --\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"filename, data\", [\n    (\"square.png\", PNG), (\"photo.jpg\", JPEG), (\"photo.jpeg\", JPEG),\n])\ndef test_step1_png_or_jpeg_with_alt_text_appears_in_the_library(client_as, role, filename, data):\n    client = client_as(role)\n    library = _upload(client, filename, data)\n\n    assert library.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Image uploaded\" in library.text\n    src = _img_src(library.text, ALT)\n    assert not src.startswith(\"/\"), src\n    image = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/admin/media\", src)).path)\n    assert image.status_code == 200\n    assert image.content == data\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"86925a72-be3f-44c2-a8ad-ed97ba20ca4c","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"39a0ae77-23dc-47a0-8ea7-552f47020b4e","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"99ff470c-95f6-4370-974e-9ebecc6ecf4a","timestamp":"2026-10-21T02:25:31.145Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\tests\\test_media.py","oldString":"@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"filename, data\", [\n    (\"square.png\", PNG), (\"photo.jpg\", JPEG), (\"photo.jpeg\", JPEG),\n])\ndef test_step1_png_or_jpeg_with_alt_text_appears_in_the_library(client_as, role, filename, data):\n    client = client_as(role)","newString":"@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"filename\", [\"square.png\", \"photo.jpg\", \"photo.jpeg\"])\ndef test_step1_png_or_jpeg_with_alt_text_appears_in_the_library(client_as, role, filename):\n    data = PNG if filename.endswith(\".png\") else JPEG\n    client = client_as(role)","originalFile":"\"\"\"MP2plus F1: media uploads with alt text (issue #21).\n\nAn Editor or Admin uploads a PNG or JPEG of 2 MB or less, with alt text, to\nthe media library; copies the item's Markdown snippet, `![alt](media/<file>)`,\ninto a Post; and `cms publish` copies media/ into site/media/ with each\n`<img src>` made relative to the page it is on. Each test is named after the\nacceptance step on #21 it checks.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport struct\nimport zlib\nfrom html import unescape\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin, urlsplit\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom app import settings\nfrom tests.conftest import extract_csrf\n\nBASE = \"http://testserver\"\n\n\ndef _png(width: int = 2, height: int = 2) -> bytes:\n    \"\"\"A real (tiny, red) PNG image, built by hand: no imaging library.\"\"\"\n    def chunk(kind: bytes, data: bytes) -> bytes:\n        return (struct.pack(\">I\", len(data)) + kind + data\n                + struct.pack(\">I\", zlib.crc32(kind + data)))\n\n    rows = b\"\".join(b\"\\x00\" + b\"\\xff\\x00\\x00\" * width for _ in range(height))\n    return (b\"\\x89PNG\\r\\n\\x1a\\n\"\n            + chunk(b\"IHDR\", struct.pack(\">IIBBBBB\", width, height, 8, 2, 0, 0, 0))\n            + chunk(b\"IDAT\", zlib.compress(rows)) + chunk(b\"IEND\", b\"\"))\n\n\nPNG = _png()\n# Starts the way every JPEG does (FF D8 FF); the server never decodes it.\nJPEG = b\"\\xff\\xd8\\xff\\xe0\\x00\\x10JFIF\\x00\" + bytes(32) + b\"\\xff\\xd9\"\nALT = \"A red square\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)\ndef media_dir(monkeypatch, tmp_path):\n    \"\"\"Uploads land in this test's own media/, never the real one.\"\"\"\n    media = tmp_path / \"media\"\n    monkeypatch.setattr(settings, \"MEDIA\", media)\n    return media\n\n\ndef _upload(client, filename: str, data: bytes, alt: str = ALT, *, csrf: str | None = None):\n    \"\"\"Send the library's upload form, with its own CSRF token unless\n    `csrf` says otherwise (\"\" leaves the token out).\"\"\"\n    token = extract_csrf(client.get(\"/admin/media\").text) if csrf is None else csrf\n    form = {\"alt_text\": alt}\n    if token:\n        form[\"csrf_token\"] = token\n    return client.post(\"/admin/media/upload\", data=form,\n                       files={\"image\": (filename, data, \"application/octet-stream\")})\n\n\ndef _img_src(html: str, alt: str) -> str:\n    tag = re.search(rf'<img [^>]*alt=\"{re.escape(alt)}\"[^>]*>', html)\n    assert tag, f\"no image {alt!r} in the page\"\n    return unescape(re.search(r'src=\"([^\"]*)\"', tag.group(0)).group(1))\n\n\n# -- Step 1: upload a PNG or JPEG of 2 MB or less; it appears in the library --\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"filename, data\", [\n    (\"square.png\", PNG), (\"photo.jpg\", JPEG), (\"photo.jpeg\", JPEG),\n])\ndef test_step1_png_or_jpeg_with_alt_text_appears_in_the_library(client_as, role, filename, data):\n    client = client_as(role)\n    library = _upload(client, filename, data)\n\n    assert library.status_code == 200\n    assert \"Image uploaded\" in library.text\n    src = _img_src(library.text, ALT)\n    assert not src.startswith(\"/\"), src\n    image = client.get(urlsplit(urljoin(BASE + \"/admin/media\", src)).path)\n    assert image.status_code == 200\n    assert image.content == data\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":68,"oldLines":10,"newStart":68,"newLines":9,"lines":[" # -- Step 1: upload a PNG or JPEG of 2 MB or less; it appears in the library --"," "," @pytest.mark.parametrize(\"role\", [\"admin\", \"editor\"])","-@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"filename, data\", [","-    (\"square.png\", PNG), (\"photo.jpg\", JPEG), (\"photo.jpeg\", JPEG),","-])","-def test_step1_png_or_jpeg_with_alt_text_appears_in_the_library(client_as, role, filename, data):","+@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"filename\", [\"square.png\", \"photo.jpg\", \"photo.jpeg\"])","+def test_step1_png_or_jpeg_with_alt_text_appears_in_the_library(client_as, role, filename):","+    data = PNG if filename.endswith(\".png\") else JPEG","     client = client_as(role)","     library = _upload(client, filename, data)"," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"16a709fc-753d-425a-a873-6ff8db5389d7","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"39a0ae77-23dc-47a0-8ea7-552f47020b4e","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

Blank lines and # comments are skipped.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        # utf-8-sig: PowerShell's Out-File writes a BOM, which would otherwise\n        # glue itself onto the first key and silently drop that variable.\n        lines = path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8-sig\").splitlines()\n    except OSError:\n        return\n    for line in lines:\n        line = line.strip()\n        if not line or line.startswith(\"#\") or \"=\" not in line:\n            continue\n        key, value = line.split(\"=\", 1)\n        key, value = key.strip(), value.strip()\n        if len(value) >= 2 and value[0] == value[-1] and value[0] in \"\\\"'\":\n            value = value[1:-1]\n        os.environ.setdefault(key, value)\n\n\nload_dotenv(ROOT / \".env\")\n\n\ndef _project_path(raw: str) -> Path:\n    path = Path(raw)\n    return path if path.is_absolute() else ROOT / path\n\n\nSECRET_KEY = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SECRET_KEY\", \"dev-only-not-for-production\")\nDATABASE_PATH = _project_path(os.environ.get(\"CMS_DATABASE\", \"cms.db\"))\nSITE_TITLE = os.environ.get(\"CMS_SITE_TITLE\", \"My CMS\")\n# Set this to your Pages URL once you deploy, e.g.\n# https://yourname.github.io/iphs400-mp2-cms/\nBASE_PATH = os.environ.get(\"CMS_BASE_PATH\", \"\")\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":13,"oldLines":6,"newStart":13,"newLines":9,"lines":[" ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]"," TEMPLATES = ROOT / \"templates\""," SITE = ROOT / \"site\"","+# Uploaded images (git-ignored, like the database); The file itself\n-- is media/<filename>; the row keeps what the file can't: its Alt text.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    filename TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    alt_text TEXT NOT NULL,\n    uploaded_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\"\"\"","originalFile":"\"\"\"SQLite connection and schema. No ORM (see spec Implementation Decisions).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom app import settings\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS content (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('post', 'page')),\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body_md TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'published')) DEFAULT 'draft',\n    author_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    -- Set on a Draft that is Scheduled (see CONTEXT.md): the UTC time after\n    -- which the next `cms publish` makes it Published. NULL otherwise.\n    publish_at TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- One row per saved version of a content item (see CONTEXT.md: Revision).\n-- `version` counts 1, 2, 3... within one item; `rolled_back_to` is set when\n-- the save was a Roll back, to the version it rolled back to.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revisions (\n    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    content_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES content(id),\n    version INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    title TEXT NOT NULL,\n    slug TEXT NOT NULL,\n    body_md TEXT NOT NULL,\n    saved_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),\n    saved_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')),\n    rolled_back_to INTEGER,\n    UNIQUE (content_id, version)\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n\n# Items saved before revisions existed get one starting revision from their\n# current state, so their pre-T15 text can still be rolled back to. The last\n# editor was never stored, so the Author stands in as who saved it. A no-op\n# once every item has a revision.\nBACKFILL_REVISIONS = \"\"\"\nINSERT INTO revisions (content_id, version, title, slug, body_md, saved_by, saved_at)\nSELECT id, 1, title, slug, body_md, author_id, updated_at FROM content\nWHERE id NOT IN (SELECT content_id FROM revisions);\n\"\"\"\n\n# Columns added to existing tables after they were first created. CREATE\n# TABLE IF NOT EXISTS never changes a table that already exists, so a database\n# made before a column existed gains it here. Maps table -> [(column, type)].\nADDED_COLUMNS = {\"content\": [(\"publish_at\", \"TEXT\")]}\n\n# Database files already brought up to date by this process.\n_schema_ready: set[str] = set()\n\n\ndef _path(db_path: Path | None) -> Path:\n    # Read lazily (settings.DATABASE_PATH) so tests can monkeypatch it per-test.\n    return db_path if db_path is not None else settings.DATABASE_PATH\n\n\ndef _open(path: Path) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(path)\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    return conn\n\n\ndef connect(db_path: Path | None = None) -> sqlite3.Connection:\n    \"\"\"Open a connection to the CMS database. The first open of each file in\n    a process runs init_db, so a database made before a newer table existed\n    works without a re-seed.\"\"\"\n    path = _path(db_path)\n    if str(Path(path).resolve()) not in _schema_ready:\n        init_db(path)\n    return _open(path)\n\n\ndef _add_missing_columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    for table, columns in ADDED_COLUMNS.items():\n        present = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n        for name, sql_type in columns:\n            if name not in present:\n                conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {name} {sql_type}\")\n\n\ndef init_db(db_path: Path | None = None) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create any missing tables and columns, and backfill starting\n    revisions. Safe to run on a new or an existing database, any number of\n    times.\"\"\"\n    path = _path(db_path)\n    conn = _open(path)\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_missing_columns(conn)\n        conn.executescript(BACKFILL_REVISIONS)\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n    _schema_ready.add(str(Path(path).resolve()))\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":47,"oldLines":6,"newStart":47,"newLines":16,"lines":["     rolled_back_to INTEGER,","     UNIQUE (content_id, version)"," );","+","+-- One row per image in the Media library (see CONTEXT.md). The file itself","+-- is media/<filename>; the row keeps what the file can't: its Alt text.","+CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS media (","+    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,","+    filename TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,","+    alt_text TEXT NOT NULL,","+    uploaded_by INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id),","+    uploaded_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))","+);"," \"\"\""," "," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false,"contentNotInModelContext":true},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"cf55ed39-a748-4b8f-8180-c8126596e151","permissionDecision":{"decision":"accept","source":"config","reasonType":"mode"},"session_id":"46a8d74b-d860-4909-a43f-d4dbcfcc3476","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms","sessionId":"39a0ae77-23dc-47a0-8ea7-552f47020b4e","version":"2.1.305","gitBranch":"main"}

No ORM\n(see spec Implementation Decisions).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\n\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom app.security import hash_password\n\nROLES = {\"admin\", \"editor\"}\n\nEMAIL_RE = re.compile(r\"^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$\")\n\n\ndef normalize_email(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Accounts are stored in this form, so every lookup must use it too.\"\"\"\n    return raw.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef validate_email(raw: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Normalize `raw` and return it if it looks like an email, else None.\"\"\"\n    normalized = normalize_email(raw)\n    return normalized if EMAIL_RE.match(normalized) else None\n\n\ndef list_users() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC\").fetchall()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef get_user(user_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,)).fetchone()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef create_user(email: str, password: str, role: str) -> int:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, active) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)\",\n            (email, hash_password(password), role),\n        )\n        conn.commit()\n        return cur.lastrowid\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef set_role(user_id: int, role: str) -> None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET role = ? WHERE id = ?\", (role, user_id))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef deactivate_user(user_id: int) -> None:\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET active = 0 WHERE id = ?\", (user_id,))\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"Content (Posts and Pages) data access. Posts and Pages share this one table and these functions,\ndistinguished only by `kind` ('post' | 'page') — see CONTEXT.md.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\n\nfrom app import db as db_module\n\nSLUG_RE = re.compile(r\"^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$\")\n\nSTATUS_DRAFT = \"draft\"\nSTATUS_PUBLISHED = \"published\"\n\n# Not a Status: a Scheduled item is a Draft with a publish_at set (see\n# CONTEXT.md). Maps kind -> {slug: what it would clobber}.\nRESERVED_SLUGS = {\"page\": {\"index\": \"the site's home page\"}}\n\n\ndef reserved_slug_reason(kind: str, slug: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"What `slug` is reserved for within `kind`, or None if it's free.\"\"\"\n    return RESERVED_SLUGS.get(kind, {}).get(slug)\n\n\ndef normalize_slug(raw: str) -> str:\n    return raw.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef validate_slug(raw: str) -> str | None:\n    \"\"\"Normalize `raw` and return it if it's a valid slug, else None.\"\"\"\n    normalized = normalize_slug(raw)\n    return normalized if SLUG_RE.match(normalized) else None\n\n\ndef to_timestamp(moment: datetime) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`moment` in the stored UTC format. {"parentUuid":"6da93931-d1df-4441-bad1-30880be102fc","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgEbAWy9t3Vuz42vW3ewg","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01Jwu4iZo3ZSM6L6nxBTk8K3","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\media.py","content":"\"\"\"The Media library: images uploaded for use in Posts, each with Alt text\n(see CONTEXT.md). The file goes in media/, which is git-ignored like the\ndatabase; its row in the `media` table keeps the Alt text. No ORM (see spec\nImplementation Decisions).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath\n\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom app import settings\n\nEXTENSIONS = {\".png\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\"}\n\n\ndef _safe_stem(filename: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The upload's own name, without folders or extension, as lowercase\n    letters, digits and hyphens: \"C:\\\\pics\\\\Team Photo (1).PNG\" -> \"team-photo-1\".\"\"\"\n    stem = PurePosixPath(filename.replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\")).stem\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", stem.lower()).strip(\"-\")[:60].strip(\"-\") or \"image\"\n\n\ndef _free_name(conn: sqlite3.Connection, filename: str, extension: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A file name for the upload that neither media/ nor the library uses\n    yet: \"team.png\", then \"team-2.png\", \"team-3.png\", ...\"\"\"\n    stem = _safe_stem(filename)\n    taken = {row[\"filename\"] for row in conn.execute(\"SELECT filename FROM media\")}\n    number = 1\n    while True:\n        name = f\"{stem}{extension}\" if number == 1 else f\"{stem}-{number}{extension}\"\n        if name not in taken and not (settings.MEDIA / name).exists():\n            return name\n        number += 1\n\n\ndef save_upload(filename: str, data: bytes, alt_text: str, uploaded_by: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Write the image to media/ under a safe, unused name and record its\n    Alt text in the library. Returns the name it was saved as.\"\"\"\n    extension = PurePosixPath(filename).suffix.lower()\n    settings.MEDIA.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        name = _free_name(conn, filename, extension)\n        path = settings.MEDIA / name\n        path.write_bytes(data)\n        try:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO media (filename, alt_text, uploaded_by) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n                (name, alt_text, uploaded_by),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n        except sqlite3.Error:\n            path.unlink()\n            raise\n        return name\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_media() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Every image in the library, newest first, with who uploaded it.\"\"\"\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT media.*, users.email AS uploaded_by_email FROM media \"\n            \"JOIN users ON users.id = media.uploaded_by ORDER BY media.id DESC\"\n        ).fetchall()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef served_file(filename: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"media/<filename>, if that is an image file directly inside media/;\n    else None, so a crafted name (\"..\\\\cms.db\", \"x.html\") is never served.\"\"\"\n    if PurePosixPath(filename).suffix.lower() not in EXTENSIONS:\n        return None\n    path = settings.MEDIA / filename\n    try:\n        inside = path.resolve().parent == settings.MEDIA.resolve()\n    except OSError:\n        return None\n    return path if inside and path.is_file() else None\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1988,"cache_read_input_tokens":175314,"output_tokens":1402,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":95},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1988,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1402,"cache_read_input_tokens":175314,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1988,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1988},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01Jwu4iZo3ZSM6L6nxBTk8K3":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"39a0ae77-23dc-47a0-8ea7-552f47020b4e","hash":"0a293a0523a931e7287c4e4abf21d58c8dbb55d005abe616a6da2d20d7915487","message":{"role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"thinking","thinking":"","signature":""},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01UWM3XbVDHY7BRmDU8YxWG2","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\app\\routes\\media.py","content":"\"\"\"The Media library (MP2plus F1, issue #21): Editors and Admins upload PNG\nand JPEG images with Alt text and copy each one's Markdown snippet into a\nPost. The admin server also serves media/ to logged-in users, so the\nlibrary's images and the editor's preview show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import media as media_module\nfrom app import security\nfrom app.guards import require_editor_or_admin\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nLIBRARY_TEMPLATE = \"admin/media_library.html\"\n\n\ndef _render_library(request, user, *, saved=None, error=None, form_alt=\"\", status_code=200):\n    csrf_token, new_cookie = security.read_or_mint_csrf(request)\n    response = templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, LIBRARY_TEMPLATE,\n        {\"title\": \"Media\", \"current_user\": user, \"csrf_token\": csrf_token,\n         \"items\": media_module.list_media(), \"saved\": saved, \"error\": error,\n         \"form_alt\": form_alt},\n        status_code=status_code,\n    )\n    return security.set_csrf_cookie(response, new_cookie)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/media\")\ndef media_library(request: Request, user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin)):\n    return _render_library(request, user, saved=request.query_params.get(\"saved\"))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/media/upload\")\ndef upload_media(\n    request: Request,\n    image: UploadFile | None = File(None),\n    alt_text: str = Form(\"\"),\n    csrf_token: str = Form(\"\"),\n    user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin),\n):\n    filename = image.filename if image else \"\"\n    data = image.file.read() if image else b\"\"\n    media_module.save_upload(filename, data, alt_text, user[\"id\"])\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin/media?saved=uploaded\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/media/{filename}\")\ndef media_file(filename: str, user=Depends(require_editor_or_admin)):\n    path = media_module.served_file(filename)\n    if path is None:\n        raise HTTPException(404)\n    return FileResponse(path, headers={\"X-Content-Type-Options\": \"nosniff\"})\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}},{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01HuPDoWEf2xoMTHLDXerVKa","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms\\templates\\admin\\media_library.html","content":"{% extends \"admin/base.html\" %}\n{% block admin_content %}\n  <div class=\"page-head\">\n    <h1>Media</h1>\n  </div>\n  {% if saved == \"uploaded\" %}<p class=\"success\">Image uploaded. Copy its Markdown into a post.</p>{% endif %}\n  {% if error %}<p class=\"error\">{{ error }}</p>{% endif %}\n  <form method=\"post\" action=\"{{ to_root }}admin/media/upload\" enctype=\"multipart/form-data\"\n        class=\"content-form card media-upload\">\n    <input type=\"hidden\" name=\"csrf_token\" value=\"{{ csrf_token }}\">\n    <label>Image (PNG or JPEG, 2 MB or less)\n      <input type=\"file\" name=\"image\" accept=\".png,.jpg,.jpeg,image/png,image/jpeg\" required>\n    </label>\n    <label>Alt text\n      <input type=\"text\" name=\"alt_text\" value=\"{{ form_alt }}\" aria-describedby=\"alt-hint\">\n    </label>\n    <p id=\"alt-hint\" class=\"media-upload__hint\">Describe the image for someone who can't see it,\n      e.g. \"Club members at the hackathon\". Raises\n    UploadRefused if nothing is left.\"\"\"\n    alt = \" \".join(raw.split())\n    if not alt:\n        raise UploadRefused(\"Add alt text: a short description of the image for \"\n                            \"someone who can't see it.\")\n    return alt\n\n","originalFile":"\"\"\"The Media library: images uploaded for use in Posts, each with Alt text\n(see CONTEXT.md). The file goes in media/, which is git-ignored like the\ndatabase; its row in the `media` table keeps the Alt text. No ORM (see spec\nImplementation Decisions).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath\n\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom app import settings\n\nEXTENSIONS = {\".png\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\"}\n\n\ndef _safe_stem(filename: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The upload's own name, without folders or extension, as lowercase\n    letters, digits and hyphens: \"C:\\\\pics\\\\Team Photo (1).PNG\" -> \"team-photo-1\".\"\"\"\n    stem = PurePosixPath(filename.replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\")).stem\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", stem.lower()).strip(\"-\")[:60].strip(\"-\") or \"image\"\n\n\ndef _free_name(conn: sqlite3.Connection, filename: str, extension: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A file name for the upload that neither media/ nor the library uses\n    yet: \"team.png\", then \"team-2.png\", \"team-3.png\", ...\"\"\"\n    stem = _safe_stem(filename)\n    taken = {row[\"filename\"] for row in conn.execute(\"SELECT filename FROM media\")}\n    number = 1\n    while True:\n        name = f\"{stem}{extension}\" if number == 1 else f\"{stem}-{number}{extension}\"\n        if name not in taken and not (settings.MEDIA / name).exists():\n            return name\n        number += 1\n\n\ndef save_upload(filename: str, data: bytes, alt_text: str, uploaded_by: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Write the image to media/ under a safe, unused name and record its\n    Alt text in the library. Returns the name it was saved as.\"\"\"\n    extension = PurePosixPath(filename).suffix.lower()\n    settings.MEDIA.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        name = _free_name(conn, filename, extension)\n        path = settings.MEDIA / name\n        path.write_bytes(data)\n        try:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO media (filename, alt_text, uploaded_by) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n                (name, alt_text, uploaded_by),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n        except sqlite3.Error:\n            path.unlink()\n            raise\n        return name\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_media() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Every image in the library, newest first, with who uploaded it.\"\"\"\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT media.*, users.email AS uploaded_by_email FROM media \"\n            \"JOIN users ON users.id = media.uploaded_by ORDER BY media.id DESC\"\n        ).fetchall()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef served_file(filename: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"media/<filename>, if that is an image file directly inside media/;\n    else None, so a crafted name (\"..\\\\cms.db\", \"x.html\") is never served.\"\"\"\n    if PurePosixPath(filename).suffix.lower() not in EXTENSIONS:\n        return None\n    path = settings.MEDIA / filename\n    try:\n        inside = path.resolve().parent == settings.MEDIA.resolve()\n    except OSError:\n        return None\n    return path if inside and path.is_file() else None\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":15,"oldLines":6,"newStart":15,"newLines":21,"lines":[" EXTENSIONS = {\".png\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\"}"," "," ","+class UploadRefused(ValueError):","+    \"\"\"An upload that breaks one of the library's rules; The admin server also serves media/ to logged-in users, so the\nlibrary's images and the editor's preview show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, File, Form, HTTPException, Request, UploadFile\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import media as media_module\nfrom app import security\nfrom app.guards import require_editor_or_admin\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nLIBRARY_TEMPLATE = \"admin/media_library.html\"\n\n\ndef _render_library(request, user, *, saved=None, The file goes in media/, which is git-ignored like the\ndatabase; its row in the `media` table keeps the Alt text. No ORM (see spec\nImplementation Decisions).\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath\n\nfrom app import db as db_module\nfrom app import settings\n\nEXTENSIONS = {\".png\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\"}\n\n\nclass UploadRefused(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"An upload that breaks one of the library's rules; the message says\n    which, in words for the upload form.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef clean_alt_text(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"`raw` on one line, with runs of spaces collapsed. Raises\n    UploadRefused if nothing is left.\"\"\"\n    alt = \" \".join(raw.split())\n    if not alt:\n        raise UploadRefused(\"Add alt text: a short description of the image for \"\n                            \"someone who can't see it.\")\n    return alt\n\n\ndef _safe_stem(filename: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The upload's own name, without folders or extension, as lowercase\n    letters, digits and hyphens: \"C:\\\\pics\\\\Team Photo (1).PNG\" -> \"team-photo-1\".\"\"\"\n    stem = PurePosixPath(filename.replace(\"\\\\\", \"/\")).stem\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", stem.lower()).strip(\"-\")[:60].strip(\"-\") or \"image\"\n\n\ndef _free_name(conn: sqlite3.Connection, filename: str, extension: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"A file name for the upload that neither media/ nor the library uses\n    yet: \"team.png\", then \"team-2.png\", \"team-3.png\", ...\"\"\"\n    stem = _safe_stem(filename)\n    taken = {row[\"filename\"] for row in conn.execute(\"SELECT filename FROM media\")}\n    number = 1\n    while True:\n        name = f\"{stem}{extension}\" if number == 1 else f\"{stem}-{number}{extension}\"\n        if name not in taken and not (settings.MEDIA / name).exists():\n            return name\n        number += 1\n\n\ndef save_upload(filename: str, data: bytes, alt_text: str, uploaded_by: int) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Write the image to media/ under a safe, unused name and record its\n    Alt text in the library. Returns the name it was saved as; raises\n    UploadRefused, storing nothing, if the upload breaks a rule.\"\"\"\n    alt_text = clean_alt_text(alt_text)\n    extension = PurePosixPath(filename).suffix.lower()\n    settings.MEDIA.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        name = _free_name(conn, filename, extension)\n        path = settings.MEDIA / name\n        path.write_bytes(data)\n        try:\n            conn.execute(\n                \"INSERT INTO media (filename, alt_text, uploaded_by) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n                (name, alt_text, uploaded_by),\n            )\n            conn.commit()\n        except sqlite3.Error:\n            path.unlink()\n            raise\n        return name\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef list_media() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Every image in the library, newest first, with who uploaded it.\"\"\"\n    conn = db_module.connect()\n    try:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"SELECT media.*, users.email AS uploaded_by_email FROM media \"\n            \"JOIN users ON users.id = media.uploaded_by ORDER BY media.id DESC\"\n        ).fetchall()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\n\ndef served_file(filename: str) -> Path | None:\n    \"\"\"media/<filename>, if that is an image file directly inside media/;\n    else None, so a crafted name (\"..\\\\cms.db\", \"x.html\") is never served.\"\"\"\n    if PurePosixPath(filename).suffix.lower() not in EXTENSIONS:\n        return None\n    path = settings.MEDIA / filename\n    try:\n        inside = path.resolve().parent == settings.MEDIA.resolve()\n    except OSError:\n        return None\n    return path if inside and path.is_file() else None\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":12,"oldLines":9,"newStart":12,"newLines":17,"lines":[" from app import db as db_module"," from app import settings"," ","-EXTENSIONS = {\".png\", \".jpg\", \".jpeg\"}","+MAX_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024  #
