The rest are left as they are, with the reason for each.\n\n### Fixed\n\n| # | Finding | Resolution |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | **Alt text with nothing visible was accepted.** It could be only a zero-width space, BOM, soft hyphen, Hangul filler or blank Braille cell. A screen reader reads it as nothing, which defeats step 2. | Alt text now needs at least one letter or digit (Unicode L or N), and the Hangul fillers don't count. `test_step2_alt_text_with_nothing_visible_is_refused` covers 6 cases. A Japanese alt (`部室の写真`) is still accepted. |\n| 2 | **The refusal message never named `\\`,** although a backslash triggers it (`C:\\pics` would render as `C:ics`). | The message now lists `\\` too. Test: `test_step5_the_refusal_names_a_backslash_when_it_refuses_one`. |\n| 3 | **A failed write left a partial file in `media/`** (e.g. a full disk after `open(\"xb\")` succeeded). `render_site` would then have published the partial file. | The upload's own file is deleted on any write failure, and the error still propagates. The test injects a full-disk `OSError` on writes into `media/` and checks that nothing is left. |\n\n### Not changed\n\n- **Editor uploads reach `site/` on the next `cms publish` with no Admin step. The library has no delete.** Same for the CLAUDE.md line \"Only published content reaches `site/`\". Anything in `media/` is public by the student's decision, and Draft *text* still never leaves the database. Deleting media is out of F1's scope.\n- **The export copies `media/` unfiltered** (non-images, subfolders, symlink targets). The student chose \"every file in `media/`\".\n- **`cms publish` can stop part way if `copytree` fails.** Same as the existing writes in `render_site`. The failure is loud, and nothing is deployed until `cms deploy` runs.\n- **A file named only `.png` is refused.** It has no name before its extension.\n- **The 2 MB check runs after Starlette has received the body.** The admin console is local-only (ADR-001).\n- **Preview `to_root` plumbing vs a fixed `/media/`.** A fixed path would put `src=\"/` into admin pages.\n- **`.gitignore` says `media/`, not `/media/`.** That's the spec's exact wording.\n- **Each upload loads every library name into a set.** Fine at this library's size.\n- **The CSRF message constant and the CSRF render pattern are repeated in another file.** This follows the existing routers.\n\n### Verification\n\n`tests/test_media.py`: 66 pass (9 new). Full suite: **352 passed**. `check_submission.py --stage 2`: **22/22**. F4's spec also clashes with T16's tests (`test_editors_see_no_schedule_controls`, the flip to Published in `test_scheduling.py`), and changing base test assertions fails the gate, which zeroes every exercise.\n\n**Rules that bite:** issue first (label `stretch`, body = acceptance table verbatim + `Blocked by: none`); phase `T<issue#>` set before the session; commit `T<issue#>: … Closes #<issue#>`; findings comment before close; tests in `tests/test_{slug}.py` named `test_step<k>_…`; screenshots `docs/screenshots/mp2plus-{slug}-{1280,390}.png`; base test files may only gain cases. Closes #21\nT21 \r\n#### F5 Site search (7 pts, about 35–50 min)\n- **Goal.** Readers find a post without scrolling. `cms publish` writes a small search index and a `search.html` page that queries it with one short script. ADR-002 rejected a JavaScript application stack, not one script on the public site; if you also do P3, that exception makes a good ADR.\n- **Prerequisites.** MP2 done and Part 0 complete. Other exercises: none.\n- **Roles.** No new admin routes.\n\n**Steps.**\n1. Create the issue (runbook 1), title `MP2plus F5: Site search`; then `echo T<issue#> > .claude/state/phase`.\n2. `/clear`, then the prompt below with your issue number. Then publish, preview with `python3 -m http.server -d site 8001`, and walk the acceptance checklist yourself; fix what fails.\n3. `/code-review`, then the close-out message (runbook 5). `gh issue view <issue#>` shows CLOSED, with your comment above the close.\n4. Save `docs/screenshots/mp2plus-search-1280.png` and `mp2plus-search-390.png`: a search with one result. Then run the two checks (runbook 8).\n\n**Prompt.**\n```text\n/implement #N Site search on the public site. Follow the issue's acceptance checklist exactly. cms publish writes site/search-index.json from published posts and pages only: title, relative URL, short excerpt. site/search.html loads one plain JavaScript file of at most 60 lines, with relative paths and no library, and the home page links to it. Rules: no href=\"/ or src=\"/ in any template, admin pages included; use url_for or relative links. Every new form carries a CSRF token and refuses a POST without it. Every new setting gets a line in .env.example. If you change the database schema, keep scripts/seed_demo.py running clean from .env.example and tell me to run rm cms.db && uv run python scripts/seed_demo.py. Tests that existed before may only gain cases; ask me before changing an existing assertion. Put the new tests in tests/test_search.py and name each one test_step<k>_<what> after the acceptance step it checks. Ask before adding any dependency.\n```\n**Acceptance checklist.**\n| # | Step | Checked by |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | `uv run cms publish` writes `site/search-index.json` with the title, relative URL and a short excerpt of each published post and page | publish, test |\n| 2 | Drafts are absent from the index | publish, test |\n| 3 | `site/search.html` loads one plain JavaScript file of 60 lines or fewer, with no external dependency and relative paths only | read |\n| 4 | Typing a word from a published post's title into `search.html` lists a link to that post, and the link opens it | walk |\n| 5 | The published home page links to `search.html` with a relative path | publish, test |\n\n**The judge runs:** publish with a draft present and read the index; preview with `python3 -m http.server -d site 8001` (opening the file directly blocks the index fetch); follow the home page's search link; search for a word from one post's title and open the result.\n- **Out of scope.** A search box in the admin, fuzzy matching, ranking, a search server, searching drafts.\n- **Deliverables.** The closed issue; `tests/test_search.py`; `docs/screenshots/mp2plus-search-1280.png` and `-390.png`; your report row.\n- **Report row.** `| F5 | issue #<n>; tests/test_search.py; mp2plus-search-1280.png, mp2plus-search-390.png |`\n- **Scoring.** Screenshots 1 · Trail 1 · Tests 1 · Function 4 = floor(4 × steps passed ÷ 5). {"parentUuid":"815731c5-7508-43c0-970f-50cb53d5787c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011CgEiEhmiypvrKzkrQx1PR","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_018eM5TGWXmG2VSBp6BgzXfc","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\rajan\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\mp2plus-handoff-05_f5-search_20261021.md","content":"# Handoff: MP2plus, F1 done → next F5 (Site search)\n\n**Written:** 2026-10-21, about 12:00am EDT\n**Repo:** `C:\\Rajan\\E disk\\My work\\IPHS400\\code\\mp2-cms` → https://github.com/Rajan-Thakur/iphs400-mp2-cms\n**Hard deadline:** tag `mp2plus-final` pushed and the email sent by **Wed 2026-10-21, 2:40pm EDT**. That's the end of the no-penalty grace. Points cap at +30.\n\n**Read first:**\n- `CLAUDE.md`\n- The project memory, especially `mp2plus.md`, `mp2-repo-reference.md` and `mp2-prose-is-human.md`. The index auto-loads.\n- The plan: `notes/mp2plus-plan.md`. The order is **F1 → F5 → F8 (carried by P1 as a branch + PR) → S1**.\n- The manual and rubric live only on the template remote:\n  - `git show template/main:docs/manual_iphs400_mp2plus-web-cms_20261012.md`: F5 is under \"#### F5 Site search\" (prompt, acceptance table, \"The judge runs\", out of scope). The runbook is under \"### The feature runbook\".\n  - `git show template/main:docs/mp2plus-grading-rubric_20261012.md`: the gate is P0.3/P0.4.\n\n## State\n\n| Item | State |\n|---|---|\n| `main` = `origin/main` | `5cf2937` (the user's commit of the F1 review-round-2 fixes). Working tree clean. |\n| F1 | Done. [#21](https://github.com/Rajan-Thakur/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/21) closed after two findings comments. Commits `c755c3f` and `5cf2937`. Screenshots are in `docs/screenshots/mp2plus-media-*.png`. |\n| Tests / checker | 352 pass (286 at `mp2plus-base` + 66 in `tests/test_media.py`). `check_submission.py --stage 2`: 22/22. |\n| `.claude/state/phase` | Still `T21`. Set it to `T<new issue#>` **before** the F5 session starts, after the issue exists. |\n| Next issue number | #22 (issues and PRs share numbering) |\n\n## Next: F5 Site search\n\n**Runbook order:**\n1. Create the issue: label `stretch`, title `MP2plus F5: Site search`. The body is the manual's F5 acceptance table word for word, then `Blocked by: none`. The user created #21 themselves; ask whether they want to do it again.\n2. Set the phase.\n3. Run the manual's F5 `/implement` prompt with the issue number. Tests go in `tests/test_search.py`, named `test_step<k>_…`.\n4. Walk at 1280 and 390, then `/code-review`, then the findings comment on the issue.\n5. **The user commits and pushes themselves.** Their words were \"Just don't do commits\". Posting the issue comment is fine once they OK it.\n6. Screenshots: `docs/screenshots/mp2plus-search-1280.png` and `-390.png`, showing a search with one result.\n\n**Codebase facts F5 will touch:**\n- **Export:** `render_site()` in `app/publish.py` writes `index.html`, `posts/<slug>.html`, `<slug>.html`, `style.css` and, since F1, `media/`.\n  - Only `content_module.list_published(...)` and `_exportable_pages()` may feed the index. Step 2 checks that drafts are absent.\n  - `home_html()` renders `templates/public/home.html`; step 5 needs a relative link to `search.html` there.\n- **Reserved slugs gotcha:** a Page with slug `search` would export to `site/search.html` and clobber the search page. `RESERVED_SLUGS` (`app/content.py:32`) reserves only `index`.\n  - Add `search` there.\n  - `tests/test_pages.py:99,112` cover the reserved-slug behaviour. Add cases only; don't edit them.\n- **Dev server parity:** `app/routes/public.py` serves the export's paths so the local preview \"can't drift\". Its catch-all `/{slug}.html` must stay last.\n  - Add `/search.html`, the JS file and `/search-index.json` before it, if the dev server should show search too.\n  - The `live_server`/`phone` Playwright fixtures in `tests/conftest.py` serve the app, not `site/`. A browser test of search needs either those routes or an `http.server` over a rendered `site/`.\n- **Excerpt:** body Markdown goes through `render_markdown`, then has its tags stripped (e.g. `nh3.clean(html, tags=set())`), then gets cut short.\n  - Titles are user content. The search script must build results with `textContent` / `createElement`, never `innerHTML`.\n  - `fetch(\"search-index.json\")` must be relative, or it breaks on Pages.\n- **60-line limit:** the JS file must be 60 lines or fewer, with no library (step 3, checked by *read*). A test can count the lines.\n- **No new setting is expected.** If one appears, it needs a line in `.env.example`.\n- **One stylesheet:** `app/style.css` serves the admin and the export. Phone-fit helper: `assert_fits_phone` in `tests/test_phone_width.py`, importable.\n\n## Lessons from F1 (apply to F5)\n\n- **The TDD skill wants the test seams agreed with the user first.** For F1 they picked HTTP via `client_as` + export via `cli.main([\"publish\"])`/`render_site` + one Playwright layer.\n- **Prove the guard tests can fail:** break each guard on purpose and confirm a test goes red. The mutation runner pattern is in the session transcript. The F1 review caught real issues every round.\n- **`check_submission.py`'s root-absolute check uses `git grep`, so it misses new untracked templates.** Run `git grep --untracked -n -e 'href=\"/' -e 'src=\"/' -- '*.html'` yourself.\n- **The user's `/code-review` close-out prompt may carry the manual's example number** (#14/\"T14\" last time). Confirm the real issue number before posting.\n- **Reusable walk script:** `C:\\Users\\rajan\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\mp2plus_walk_media.py`. It isolates `settings.DATABASE_PATH/MEDIA/SITE`, runs uvicorn in a thread, drives Playwright at 1280/390, runs `cms publish`, serves `site/` with `python -m http.server`, and `--shots` writes the screenshots.\n  - Adapt it for search: publish with a draft present, follow the home page's search link, search a title word, open the result.\n  - Run: `export PYTHONPATH= PYTHONUTF8=1; \"$UV\" run python <script> \"$PWD\" <scratch-workdir> [--shots]`\n- **Environment quirks** (also in memory `mp2-repo-reference.md`):\n  - Use `export PYTHONPATH=` before every `uv run`. `uv` is not on PATH (full path in memory).\n  - `PYTHONUTF8=1` for the checker and for any non-cp1252 output.\n  - Bash heredocs turn `\\\\` and `\\'` into `\\` and `'`. Write Python containing those with Write/Edit.\n- **The user's real `cms.db` holds the client site.** New tables come in through `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS`, so never suggest `rm cms.db` without a backup.\n\n## After F5\n\n- **F8 via P1:** branch `mp2plus-theme` + PR. Findings go on the PR, plus a one-line link on the issue. The admin-only Settings page is `/admin/settings`.\n- **S1:** the router-walk snag is in memory `mp2plus.md`.\n- **Then the user's own items:**\n  - report rows in `docs/iphs400_mp2plus-web-cms_report_rajan-thakur_<YYYYMMDD>.md` (prose is theirs)\n  - the `mp2plus-final` tag\n  - the email\n\n## Suggested skills\n\n- `mattpocock-skills:implement`: drives F5 from the issue. Manual and rubric live only on `template/main` (0a9eee4): `docs/manual_iphs400_mp2plus-web-cms_20261012.md`, `docs/mp2plus-grading-rubric_20261012.md`.\n\n**State on 2026-10-20 ~8:20pm EDT:** `mp2plus-base` = `mp2-final` = 42f91f7, both pushed. Plan committed as 8ddb990 (`mp2plus: plan`): F1, F4, F5, F8. Base results: checker 22/22, 286 tests. Phase file says `revise`.\n\n**Decided 2026-10-20:** F4 dropped. F1: `cms publish` copies **every** file in `media/` (the user's call: anything in `media/` is meant to be public), and the admin serves `/media/` to logged-in users so library thumbnails and the editor's preview work. The Alt text rule is a round trip through `render_markdown`, not a character list. A second /code-review round left 3 fixes **uncommitted** (invisible-only alt text, the backslash named in the message, partial-file cleanup; 352 tests). The round-2 findings comment is posted on #21. The user said \"Just don't do commits\": they commit and push themselves. Their `/code-review` prompt said #14/T14 by mistake (copied from the manual's example); it is #21. Still the user's to do: commit, push, the report row. Next issue number: #22.\n\n**S1 snag:** admin-only routes depend on wrapper closures (`_require_admin_to_publish`, `_require_admin_to_schedule` in `content_crud.py`, `_require_admin_for_users` in `users.py`) that call `require_admin` inside, so a router walk can't see `require_admin`. S1 needs a marker on those dependencies.\n\n**F4 conflict (flagged to the user):** T16 (#18) already shipped scheduled publishing, so F4 scores 0 (\"a feature already present at mp2plus-base is not scored again\"). F4's spec also clashes with T16's tests (`test_editors_see_no_schedule_controls`, the flip to Published in `test_scheduling.py`), and changing base test assertions fails the gate, which zeroes every exercise.\n\n**Rules that bite:** issue first (label `stretch`, body = acceptance table verbatim + `Blocked by: none`); phase `T<issue#>` set before the session; commit `T<issue#>: … Closes #<issue#>`; findings comment before close; tests in `tests/test_{slug}.py` named `test_step<k>_…`; screenshots `docs/screenshots/mp2plus-{slug}-{1280,390}.png`; base test files may only gain cases. Issues and PRs share numbering. `/mattpocock-skills:implement` works when invoked by name, even though the skill list doesn't show it.\n\n**Codebase facts:** one stylesheet `app/style.css` serves both the admin (`/style.css` route in `app/routes/public.py`) and the export (`CSS` constant read at import in `app/publish.py`).
